plan.title: Fitness Programme Results
plan.subtitle: An overview of the programme's impact.

panels.title: Total children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM endline

panels.title: Average score by location
panels.sql: SELECT Location, AVG(Shuttle run sec) AS avg_shuttle_run FROM endline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', DOB) AS month, SUM(Shuttle run sec) AS total FROM endline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 fastest shuttle run times
panels.sql: SELECT Child name, Shuttle run sec FROM endline ORDER BY Shuttle run sec ASC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The programme has reached {{p1}} children. The average shuttle run time varies across locations, with the fastest times observed in {{p4.Child name}}.  The trend in average shuttle run time over the months is shown in {{p3.month}}.  Overall, the programme appears to be having a positive impact on the children's fitness.
